subject: ddl: make meta mutator part of jobContext (#56399)
summary: Refactor-only change in `pkg/ddl`: introduces `jobContext.metaMut *meta.Mutator` (set once per DDL-step txn in `worker.transitOneJobStep`) and rewires DDL handlers (incl. add-index/reorg paths) to use `jobCtx.metaMut` instead of threading `*meta.Mutator` through function params. Also moves per-job logging to `jobContext.logger` (wired from scheduler with trace info). Transaction boundaries and metadata/state-machine updates (schema diff, table/db meta writes, add-index reorg) remain structurally the same; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/consistency/concurrency within the reviewed diff.
